verdict.rationale: The Guichet unique is an online portal for company formalities, so scheduling recurring filings or workflows is a fair automation question for it. However, the evidence only documents one-off online filings, dashboards for tracking, and payment options; nothing shows a scheduler or recurring-job capability. The keyless recherche-entreprises API probe concerns a separate state data API and only shows read access, not scheduling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
